title: Body, mind and printed matter: Angela Lian on how she exercises creative muscles as well as her body’s

paragraphs.text: Chinese-Taiwanese artist co-founder of It’s Happening Angela Lian joined us on our New York Nicer Tuesdays stage in June – and she made it very clear that one thing is a constant through all of her work: pain. The artist centres chronic pain and illness in her work (like many designers, she’s always dealing with posture issues and back pains!) and she delivered a brilliant talk on how her work exercises not just her creative muscles but her body’s too, revealing how her design work at Baggu brings together the clear-minded and the beautifully printed.
paragraphs.translation: 中台裔藝術家暨 It’s Happening 共同創辦人 Angela Lian，於六月登上了我們在紐約舉辦的 Nicer Tuesdays 舞台，她非常明確地表示，有一件事貫穿了她所有的作品：疼痛。這位藝術家將慢性疼痛與疾病置於其創作核心（就像許多設計師一樣，她總是得應對姿勢不良和背痛的問題！）。她發表了一場精彩的演講，內容關於她的工作如何不僅鍛鍊她的創意肌肉，也鍛鍊她的身體，並揭示了她在 Baggu 的設計工作如何將思緒清明與精美的印刷結合在一起。

paragraphs.text: We’re excited to partner with Love Corn the UK’s first crunchy corn brand as our snack sponsor. Its delicious crunchy corn kernels are packed with flavour and made with love. On trend with being low sugar, gluten-free and vegan, it’s the feel good snack so please enjoy!
paragraphs.translation: 我們很高興能與英國首個脆玉米品牌 Love Corn 合作，由其擔任我們的點心贊助商。其美味的脆玉米粒充滿風味且用心製作。符合低糖、無麩質和全素的趨勢，這是一款能讓人心情愉悅的零食，請盡情享用！
